name: Kirindael
description: A qilin of storm and clean light, relaunched with a faster purification cycle. It burns impurity into stored voltage, accelerates through direct victories, and turns a full charge into a battlefield-wide lightning zone.

special_move.name: 🌩️ Lightning Purifier
special_move.description: Deals 145 + 40% ATK + 50% DEF + 80% STM damage. Opens a 4-round Purification Domain and cleanses negative effects. Purified State: +20% ATK/DEF, +15% Stability and -25% action Stability costs. Incoming debuffs retain 50% strength; each conversion banks +5% damage for the next successful damaging action (max +15%). Enemy: -5% ATK/DEF, +30% action Stability costs, -25% healing/lifesteal. Enemy Special or triggered avatar Skill grants a Purity Mark; 2 marks cause 40 + 15% Kirindael ATK true damage once per Domain. Spends 60 Purifier Charge.

ability.name: Horn of Purity
ability.description: The first debuff aimed at Kirindael is purified outright, and the horn's light lingers: 2 rounds of Purification Protection during which nothing else can stick. Each successful purification banks +25 Purifier Charge. Once the light fades, the horn can purify again.

abilities.name: Spark Rush
abilities.description: Kirindael now builds momentum without waiting for the opponent: every Attack win banks +10 Purifier Charge. When both blades commit to Attack, Spark Rush erupts for +25% damage and +25 Purifier Charge.
